title: System Functions
description: The system will provide a job coach recommender system designed to guide each person on their journey.

title: Detailed Functional Specification
description: The system will initiate text-based conversations with users through a mobile application, analyze and extract pertinent details from the user’s responses, and provide a tailored strategy to steer individuals toward fulfilling and enjoyable job options.

title: Skill Extraction Module
description: The system will extract skills from unstructured CVs and JDs.

title: Word2Vec Model
description: The system will use a Word2Vec model to create dense vectors of skills.

title: Feature Selection
description: The system will select a representative subset of skills using feature selection.

title: Ranking
description: The system will use a ranking algorithm to determine which n JDs are most suitable for a specific job seeker.

title: User Characteristics
description: The system will consider user characteristics such as skills and interests.

title: Objectives
description: The system will have objectives such as providing a personalized experience and increasing user engagement.
